payload.question: When someone is threatened with homelessness, does the council find them somewhere?
payload.label: Homelessness prevention duties ending in suitable housing, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council raised its own target for this indicator from 67% to 75% during this quarter, so the traffic lights on earlier quarters were set against an easier bar. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: If you are about to lose your home, the council has a legal duty to try to prevent it. This counts the cases where that duty ended because somewhere suitable was found. The council aims for 75% and reached 82% in the first quarter of 2025/26.
